material_traversal.measurement: First outbound base-projection passage from the west to east strip boundary without a side exit, with actual material-loaded feet during that passage. Uses original strip geometry and500Hz recorded states; no extra physical termination threshold or route change.

technical_startup.cause: w48_build.py replaced rather than merged the retained r35 configuration_overrides; generated formal model lacked r12_trunk_clearance while r12_substep_path was enabled.
technical_startup.native_startup_rollout_integrations: Partial/unavailable exact count: failure before nominal pool returns and native counter write; these are not zero physics work.
technical_startup.debugger: One attempted sibling attach denied by Yama; explicit per-child ptracer permission then actual original-attempt crash stack captured. Temporary stop/ptracer code removed.

limitations: Full 1904 boundary JSONL is in server/Release originals; only 237 available event boundaries were independently audited here.
Quaternion tangent values and paired trajectory exact-equality claims are submitted evidence, not independent native replays.
20ms prior-prediction error includes intervening closed-loop execution and does not identify a unique dynamics cause.
Missing per-substep/raw GPU initialization fields prevent a unique numerical vs hidden-state attribution.
Delivery metadata from Git is not a new live GitHub asset lookup; old technical manifests require separate remote reconciliation.
